name: premiere-pro-full-mcp
description: Local-first Adobe Premiere Pro MCP: 354 flat tools over a dual-track CEP + UXP bridge. No auth, no approval, no actionId.

interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to the local Premiere Pro Full MCP bridge over one persistent WebSocket with a dual CEP + UXP track. UXP unlocks frame capture, video transitions, clip move/remove/trim, effects, and track mute. Every operation is its own flat tool (set_active_sequence, add_to_timeline, split_clip, export_frame, ...). No auth, no approval dialogs, no hidden actionId.
defaultPrompt: List the sequences in my open Premiere project
Activate sequence X, add this clip to the timeline, and split it at 5s
Inspect the active sequence tracks and summarize the edit
